customization.summary: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Code Interpreter, directly invoked using boto3; not classic Bedrock model-mediated code interpretation, AgentCore Runtime BYOC, or a self-managed EC2/Firecracker VM. The adapter selects a pre-existing tool and region and requests only a session name and timeout. Package customization remains unverified; file operations are documented but this adapter is text-only and collects one hard-coded output.

features.notes: Reviewed CreateCodeInterpreter and StartCodeInterpreterSession APIs expose no custom image input. A custom interpreter means network/role/certificate/filesystem configuration, not BYOC. AgentCore Runtime container deployment is a different product path.

Prebuilt runtimes and terminal commands are documented; current readiness/CPU/SQLite/repository/output/inventory trials do not install a package or prove arbitrary dependencies. Acquisition depends on networking and permissions.
No CPU sizing field in reviewed create/start APIs. Guest inventory shows two visible/affinity CPUs; this is not a configurable reservation or consumed CPU billing measurement.
No RAM sizing field in reviewed create/start APIs. Guest inventory reports about 7.83 GiB physical memory; consumed/billable memory and reservation remain unattested.

No accelerator selection in reviewed Code Interpreter APIs. New guest inventory has no nvidia-smi device output, which cannot establish platform-wide GPU eligibility. Runtime Instances/EC2 GPU pricing is a separate product.

Custom interpreters support PUBLIC, SANDBOX and VPC; VPC specifies subnets/security groups. SANDBOX allows limited AWS-service access such as S3, not general public egress. The adapter comment declares SANDBOX but does not fetch tool configuration or set network mode; effective tested mode remains unattested.

Default files persist within a session, not a durable cross-session filesystem. Current docs support customer-owned S3 Files/EFS mounts with VPC, IAM, mount targets and security groups, but no managed Code Interpreter session-storage option. Adapter supplies no mounts; persistence untested.

Multiple invocations may share sessionId/state until stop or timeout. Default timeout 900s, maximum 28800s. Adapter starts a fresh session on every execute with max(request.timeout_seconds,60), then stops in cleanup; cross-invocation reuse untested.
Official executeCommand/startCommandExecution terminal APIs exist. Adapter currently calls executeCode with Python; the selected readiness evaluation does not exercise a shell.

Service documents file upload/download and 100MB inline support. Adapter decodes inputs as UTF-8 with errors=ignore and collects only transformed_output.txt as text, so its binary-transfer capability declaration is not implemented byte-faithfully. Selected evaluation contains no artifact check.
Reviewed interpreter APIs/docs and adapter do not establish arbitrary inbound ports or public preview URLs. Public outbound network mode is not inbound port exposure.
Fully managed Code Interpreter tool; direct API use without an LLM does not make the runtime self-hosted. Self-managed EC2/container/Firecracker and AgentCore Runtime are separate paths.

Adapter declares cmek_supported=true, but reviewed create/start schemas expose no customer-managed KMS key input for the interpreter runtime. General AgentCore encryption docs enumerate Memory/Gateway support, not an interpreter guarantee. Customer-owned storage encryption is a separate surface; no key attestation in report.

pricing.model: Code Interpreter actual CPU consumption and peak memory consumed up to each second over session lifetime, including system overhead; per-second increments, 1-second minimum and 128MB minimum memory billing.

rates.unit: GB-hour (peak consumed up to each second)

pricing.limitations: Official Code Interpreter rates reviewed 2026-10-13; these are not Runtime v2 or GPU instance rates. AWS pricing labels memory GB, not GiB. CPU can be uncharged during zero-CPU I/O wait, but memory is independently billed under the peak-consumption rule. Report's flat $0.00003/second times client wall time is estimate_unverified_rates with billing_verified=false, not resource-metered cost or a bill. Deployment region defaults to eu-north-1 but the saved adapter-defaults configuration does not attest the resolved tool/region or an account-specific price. No historical price increase claimed.
